rules.statement: An execution-creditor who purchases property at an execution sale through another person, in contravention of the terms set by the court under section 272 of the Civil Procedure Code, can still enforce a trust and obtain reconveyance of the property.
rules.supporting_quote: "But for the purpose of this appeal we may accept that decision so far as the meaning of section 272 is concerned, that is to say, it would be an evasion of section 272 for an execution-creditor to purchase at the execution sale either without the sanction of the Court or in contravention of the terms mentioned in the order, whether he does so himself or through an agent. But the same decision held that any objection to a Fiscal's sale for the disregard of the provisions of section 272 must be taken within time under section 282 of the Civil Procedure Code, and that after the confirmation of the sale any objection to the sale would come too late."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 272 of the Civil Procedure Code
